question: How should interior whitespace and blank lines, including trailing blank lines, be handled?
why_it_matters: This determines whether normalization preserves intentional spacing and exact line counts.
recommendation_reason: Preserving content inside lines and existing blank lines avoids unintended information loss.

options.description: Preserve interior whitespace and all blank lines, including trailing blank lines.
Collapse interior whitespace and remove all blank lines.
Preserve interior whitespace and interior blank lines, but remove trailing blank lines.
